scenarios.title: Customer without e-mail
scenarios.rationale: Placeholder generation is untested by random samples
scenarios.extraction_query: SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER WHERE EMAIL IS NULL FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

scenarios.title: Customers sharing the same e-mail
scenarios.rationale: Merge logic keeps the latest record
scenarios.extraction_query: SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER WHERE EMAIL IN (SELECT EMAIL FROM CUSTOMER GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY

scenarios.title: Soft-deleted customer with orders
scenarios.rationale: Excluded customers must not drag orders along
scenarios.extraction_query: SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER WHERE DELETED_FLAG = 'Y' FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

scenarios.title: Order total exactly zero
scenarios.rationale: Lower boundary of the review rule
scenarios.extraction_query: SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER_ORDER WHERE TOTAL_EUR = 0 FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

scenarios.title: Order total above 10000
scenarios.rationale: Upper boundary needing a second approval
scenarios.extraction_query: SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER_ORDER WHERE TOTAL_EUR > 10000 FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

scenarios.title: Late-arriving order
scenarios.extraction_query: SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER_ORDER WHERE LOAD_LAG_DAYS > 2 FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

scenarios.title: Suspended customer
scenarios.extraction_query: SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER WHERE STATUS = 'S' FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

scenarios.title: Corrected order
scenarios.rationale: Corrections reference an earlier order; seen in profile (1.3 percent)
scenarios.extraction_query: SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER_ORDER WHERE CORRECTION_OF IS NOT NULL FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

scenarios.title: Two orders of one customer tied on order date
scenarios.rationale: No rule in the code breaks ties; behaviour of the target is unknown

coverage_gaps.reason: No tie-breaking rule in the code and no ties found in the profile
